name: Exploding Nail
body:
Price 1,500 gp; Aura moderate evocation; CL 10; Weight 1/2 lb.

DESCRIPTION

Glowing as though red hot, this nail seethes with stored energy. The nail does nothing until firmly planted into a solid object, this is a standard action and the nail can be pushed into any material with hardness less than 20, though it deals no damage to the object.

After being planted in this way it becomes invisible and any creature that comes within 10 feet of the nail causes it to explode in a fireball that deals 10d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 14 half) to each creature within 20 feet of the nail. This destroys the nail.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 750 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, fireball
